# Crosswalk

> Crosswalk is an opted-in consumer panel of 30 million people worldwide, 10 million of them in the US. It reads what audiences actually do across their entire digital life, and Digital Twins IQ builds a digital twin of each US panelist from observed behavior.

Crosswalk Technologies, Inc. serves studios, streamers, brands, agencies, and finance teams. Prometheus answers audience questions in plain English from the same panel. Clients receive group statistics projected to the US population; no individual is identified.

Key facts: 30 million opted-in people worldwide, 10 million in the US, census matched and projected to 329.9 million Americans. One ID per person across phone, laptop and TV. Recorded day by day since January 2021; yesterday's behavior is on file today. Digital Twins IQ (also called Twin IQ) builds a digital twin of any audience from 5+ years of observed behavior; a twin is made of 12 to 16 archetypes; a focus group seats one archetype representative per archetype; every count carries a range and says how firm it is (firm, leaning or early); every call is dated before its outcome and scored on a public track record.

How it differs from other digital twins and synthetic respondents: it is built from what real people did, not from surveys, interviews or chatbot personas. 10 million real people stand behind every answer, about 1 in 33 Americans, with more than 2,000 days of history. Answers are counted in people, hold steady when the same question is asked the same day, and are checked against real results in public: on the first six scored calls, all three winners were called right and the counts landed within 3.2% on average.

The full text of the digital twins, synthetic data and panel pages is at https://www.crosswalknyc.com/llms-full.txt.

## Learn: digital twins, synthetic data and the behavioral panel
- [Digital Twins IQ methodology](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/digital-twins-methodology.html): How Crosswalk builds a digital twin from 5+ years of real behavior on 10 million US people instead of surveys or chatbots: archetypes, people-weighted counts, how firm each count is, pilot testing, and a public record of every call.
- [What is a digital twin audience?](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/what-is-a-digital-twin-audience.html): A digital twin audience is a working copy of a real group of people you can ask questions. Why twins built from real behavior are better than survey and chatbot twins, and how Crosswalk builds every twin from 10 million real people.
- [Synthetic data in market research](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/synthetic-data-market-research.html): Synthetic data is research produced rather than collected. The three ways it gets made, six checks before you trust it, and why Crosswalk's synthetic data, built on what 10 million real people did, meets all six.
- [Synthetic respondents vs behavioral digital twins](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/synthetic-respondents-vs-behavioral-twins.html): Interview twins, survey twins, chatbot personas, census-built populations and behavior-built twins compared side by side, and ten reasons Crosswalk's behavior-built twins are stronger.
- [How an AI focus group works](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/ai-focus-groups.html): How an AI focus group works and why a Crosswalk room is better than a traditional group: every seat stands for real people, the count adds them up, the same question gives the same count, and every count says how firm it is.
- [What is a behavioral panel?](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/behavioral-panel.html): A behavioral panel counts what people do instead of asking. Why Crosswalk's opted-in panel, 10 million US people on every screen under one ID since 2021, sees more than surveys or a platform's own data.
- [Digital Twins IQ glossary](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/digital-twins-glossary.html): Plain definitions of the words Crosswalk uses for digital twins, synthetic data and the behavioral panel, from twin, archetype and seat to how firm, the dial, behavior-built twin and chatbot persona.

## Products
- [Digital Twins IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/digital-twins.html): Digital Twins IQ builds a digital twin of each of the 10 million US people in the Crosswalk panel, from observed behavior, not surveys. Test a plan, a title, or a price first.
- [Attribution IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/attribution-iq.html): Attribution IQ reads the same people across every touch, paid and organic, and splits the credit along the path they actually took. Refreshed daily while the campaign runs.
- [Brand Partnership IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/brand-partnership-iq.html): Brand Partnership IQ puts a dollar figure on a partnership after it runs: earned media, brand engagement, brand lift, and conversion on the same people, each priced.
- [Digital Journey IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/digital-journey-iq.html): Digital Journey IQ lays out the steps people took around a campaign, a title, or a launch, in order, across their entire digital life, not just the last click.
- [Fin IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/fin-iq.html): Fin IQ is the desk's read of the same opted-in panel: platforms, tickers, and consumer movement counted in window. Not a price feed and not a delayed filing.
- [Flywheel IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/flywheel-iq.html): Flywheel IQ follows the same accounts from one title to the next owned surface, the checkout, and the return of accounts that had lapsed.
- [Micro-series](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/micro-series.html): Who watches vertical dramas on ReelShort, DramaBox, GoodShort, NetShort and Peacock, who pays, and where the paywall sits. Counted from 10 million US people, updated daily.
- [Profile IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/profile-iq.html): Profile IQ is a behavioral read on any audience: who engages with a title, talent, brand, or team, their demographic shape, and the brands and platforms they over-index on.
- [Prometheus](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/prometheus.html): Prometheus is Crosswalk's research assistant. Ask any audience question in plain English and it answers from what 10 million US people do, recorded day by day since 2021.
- [Rankers IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/ranker-iq.html): Rankers IQ ranks free ad-supported TV, streaming, music, podcasts, and gaming on observed behavior, updated every morning. Not a follower count.
- [Subscriber IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/subscriber-iq.html): Subscriber IQ ties account opens, returns, and cancels to the titles and windows that moved them, on the same opted-in people. A play is not a signup.
- [Trends IQ](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/trends-iq.html): Trends IQ ranks what moved yesterday: searches, headlines, people, books, comics, Broadway, and the box office, day over day on the same 30 million people.
- [Digital twins track record](https://www.crosswalknyc.com/twins-track-record.html): Every call the Crosswalk twins make goes on the record before the outcome, dated and hashed, then scored when it lands. The method, how firm each count is, and the record.
